```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(svglite)

# ── Output directory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
svg_dir <- "svg_outputs"
dir.create(svg_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_svg <- function(plot, filename, width = 14, height = 7) {
  if (!is.null(plot)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(svg_dir, paste0(filename, ".svg")),
      plot     = plot,
      device   = "svg",
      width    = width,
      height   = height
    )
  }
}
```

## Methylation ORA

```{r methylation_ora}
methyl_ora <- read.csv("/all_summaries/significant_methylation_ORA.csv")

make_combined_ora <- function(data, analysis_name) {
  sig <- data %>% filter(analysis == analysis_name)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) { message("No data for ", analysis_name); return(NULL) }

  summary_df <- sig %>%
    group_by(pathway_clean, direction) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(n_signed = ifelse(direction == "Hypomethylated", -n, n)) |> drop_na()

  pathway_order <- summary_df %>%
    group_by(pathway_clean) %>%
    summarise(net = sum(n_signed)) %>%
    arrange(net) %>%
    pull(pathway_clean)

  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(pathway_clean = factor(pathway_clean, levels = pathway_order))

  x_lim <- max(abs(summary_df$n_signed)) + 1.5

  p_bar <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = n_signed, y = pathway_clean, fill = direction)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Hypermethylated" = "firebrick",
                                 "Hypomethylated"  = "steelblue")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-x_lim, x_lim),
                       labels = function(x) abs(x),
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(title = paste0(analysis_name, " (Methylation ORA)"),
         x = "Number of cancer types", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position    = "top",
          axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7),
          axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank())

  tile_df <- sig %>%
    mutate(
      pathway_clean = factor(pathway_clean, levels = pathway_order),
      prop_DE       = DE / N
    ) |> drop_na(cancer_type, direction, prop_DE)

  p_tile <- ggplot(tile_df, aes(x = cancer_type, y = pathway_clean,
                                color = direction, size = prop_DE)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Hypermethylated" = "firebrick",
                                  "Hypomethylated"  = "steelblue")) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "DE/N", range = c(1, 5)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position  = "none",
          axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
          axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  p_bar + p_tile + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))
}

p <- make_combined_ora(methyl_ora, "BMI");    save_svg(p, "methylation_ORA_BMI");    p
p <- make_combined_ora(methyl_ora, "AGE");    save_svg(p, "methylation_ORA_AGE");    p
p <- make_combined_ora(methyl_ora, "GENDER"); save_svg(p, "methylation_ORA_GENDER"); p
```

## Methylation Spearman fgsea

```{r methylation_spearman_fgsea}
methyl_spearman <- read.csv("/all_summaries/significant_methylation_spearman_fgsea.csv")

make_combined_nes <- function(data, analysis_name, data_label) {
  sig <- data %>% filter(analysis == analysis_name)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) { message("No data for ", analysis_name); return(NULL) }

  summary_df <- sig %>%
    group_by(pathway_clean, direction) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(n_signed = ifelse(direction == "Downregulated", -n, n))

  pathway_order <- summary_df %>%
    group_by(pathway_clean) %>%
    summarise(net = sum(n_signed)) %>%
    arrange(net) %>%
    pull(pathway_clean)

  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(pathway_clean = factor(pathway_clean, levels = pathway_order))

  x_lim <- max(abs(summary_df$n_signed)) + 1.5

  p_bar <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = n_signed, y = pathway_clean, fill = direction)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated"   = "firebrick",
                                 "Downregulated" = "steelblue")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-x_lim, x_lim),
                       labels = function(x) abs(x),
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(title = paste0(analysis_name, " (", data_label, ")"),
         x = "Number of cancer types", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position    = "top",
          axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7),
          axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank())

  tile_df <- sig %>%
    mutate(
      pathway_clean = factor(pathway_clean, levels = pathway_order),
      abs_NES       = abs(NES)
    )

  p_tile <- ggplot(tile_df, aes(x = cancer_type, y = pathway_clean,
                                color = direction, size = abs_NES)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated"   = "firebrick",
                                  "Downregulated" = "steelblue")) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "|NES|", range = c(1, 5)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position  = "none",
          axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
          axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  p_bar + p_tile + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))
}

p <- make_combined_nes(methyl_spearman, "BMI", "Methylation Spearman fgsea"); save_svg(p, "methylation_spearman_BMI"); p
p <- make_combined_nes(methyl_spearman, "AGE", "Methylation Spearman fgsea"); save_svg(p, "methylation_spearman_AGE"); p
```

```{r rna_goseq_ora}
rna_goseq <- read.csv("/all_summaries/significant_RNA_goseq_ORA.csv")

make_combined_goseq <- function(data, analysis_name) {
  sig <- data %>% filter(analysis == analysis_name)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) { message("No data for ", analysis_name); return(NULL) }

  summary_df <- sig %>%

    mutate(n_signed = ifelse(direction == "Downregulated", -n, n))

  pathway_order <- summary_df %>%
    group_by(pathway_clean) %>%
    summarise(net = sum(n_signed)) %>%
    arrange(net) %>%
    pull(pathway_clean)

  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(pathway_clean = factor(pathway_clean, levels = pathway_order))

  x_lim <- max(abs(summary_df$n_signed)) + 1.5

  p_bar <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = n_signed, y = pathway_clean, fill = direction)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated"   = "firebrick",
                                 "Downregulated" = "steelblue")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-x_lim, x_lim),
                       labels = function(x) abs(x),
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(title = paste0(analysis_name, " (RNA GOseq ORA)"),
         x = "Number of cancer types", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position    = "top",
          axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7),
          axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank())

  tile_df <- sig %>%
    mutate(pathway_clean = factor(pathway_clean, levels = pathway_order))

  p_tile <- ggplot(tile_df, aes(x = cancer_type, y = pathway_clean,
                                color = direction, size = numDEInCat)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated"   = "firebrick",
                                  "Downregulated" = "steelblue")) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "DE in cat", range = c(1, 5)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position  = "none",
          axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
          axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  p_bar + p_tile + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))
}

p <- make_combined_goseq(rna_goseq, "BMI");    save_svg(p, "RNA_goseq_BMI");    p
p <- make_combined_goseq(rna_goseq, "AGE");    save_svg(p, "RNA_goseq_AGE");    p
p <- make_combined_goseq(rna_goseq, "GENDER"); save_svg(p, "RNA_goseq_GENDER"); p
```
